title: E-commerce Operations Manager
description:
**Pay:** ₹20,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Job description:

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive **E-commerce Operations Executive** to manage multiple e-commerce tasks including seller account creation, product listing, inventory management, order dispatch, and packaging. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with online marketplaces and strong organizational skills.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Seller Account Creation & Management**

* Create and manage seller accounts on platforms like Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra, Nykaa, AJIO, etc.
* Handle KYC documentation, GST, bank details, and onboarding processes.
* Coordinate with platform support for account approvals and issues.

**2. Product Listing & Catalog Management**

* Create accurate product listings with images, descriptions, pricing, and keywords.
* Optimize listings for better visibility and sales (SEO for e-commerce).
* Update product details, variations, and pricing regularly.

**3. Inventory Management**

* Track stock levels across platforms and warehouses.
* Maintain inventory records and avoid stock-outs or overstocking.
* Coordinate with procurement and production teams.

**4. Order Processing & Dispatch**

* Process orders received from marketplaces.
* Coordinate with courier partners and marketplaces for dispatch.
* Generate invoices and shipping labels.

**5. Packaging & Quality Check**

* Ensure proper packaging as per marketplace guidelines.
* Perform quality checks before dispatch to reduce returns.
* Manage packaging materials and labeling.

**6. Reporting & Coordination**

* Prepare daily/weekly sales and inventory reports.
* Coordinate with marketing and customer support teams.
* Handle returns, cancellations, and customer queries (basic level).

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* Experience in e-commerce operations (Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra, etc.)
* Knowledge of seller dashboards and marketplace policies
* Basic knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets for inventory and reporting
* Good communication and coordination skills
* Attention to detail and multitasking ability

**Preferred Skills (Good to Have):**

* Experience in digital marketing or ads on marketplaces
* Knowledge of GST, invoicing, and compliance
* Basic knowledge of Photoshop/Canva for product images

**Education:**

* Graduate in any field (Commerce / Management preferred)

**Why Join Us:**

* Growth opportunity in a fast-growing e-commerce brand
* Learning exposure to multiple marketplaces
* Friendly and supportive work environment

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Work Location: In person

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

title: Assistant Manager – Projects & Operations (Mechanical - Automation - SPM)
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Assistant Manager – Projects & Operations** with a strong Mechanical Engineering background. The candidate will be responsible for supporting and managing project execution, site operations, manpower, materials, installation activities, client coordination, and ensuring projects are completed within the required timeline, quality standards, and budget.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

* Plan, coordinate, and monitor mechanical projects from execution to final completion.
* Support the Project Manager in managing daily project and operational activities.
* Prepare project schedules, work plans, progress reports, and resource requirements.
* Coordinate with clients, vendors, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal departments.
* Supervise mechanical installation, fabrication, assembly, commissioning, and maintenance activities.
* Monitor site manpower and ensure optimum utilization of available resources.
* Ensure required materials, tools, equipment, and manpower are available as per project schedules.
* Track project progress and identify delays, risks, and operational issues.
* Take necessary action and provide solutions to ensure timely project completion.
* Ensure all work is carried out according to approved drawings, technical specifications, and quality standards.
* Conduct regular site inspections and monitor work quality and productivity.
* Coordinate with the Purchase and Stores departments for timely material availability.
* Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly project progress reports.
* Monitor project costs and support management in controlling unnecessary expenses.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and site safety requirements.
* Coordinate with Electrical, Automation, Civil, and other departments wherever required.
* Attend client meetings and provide project updates when required.
* Manage project documentation, including drawings, work reports, material records, and handover documents.
* Support project commissioning, testing, final inspection, and handover activities.
* Lead and guide engineers, technicians, supervisors, and site workers.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong knowledge of Mechanical Engineering and project execution.
* Experience in mechanical installation, fabrication, assembly, and site operations.
* Good project planning, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and site activities simultaneously.
* Strong knowledge of engineering drawings and technical documentation.
* Knowledge of AutoCAD and MS Office is preferred.
* Good knowledge of material planning and manpower management.
* Ability to handle vendors, subcontractors, and client coordination.
* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Good communication and reporting skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet strict project deadlines.
* Willingness to travel and work at project sites as required.

Preferred Experience

* **5–6 years of experience** in Mechanical Projects and Operations.
* Experience in **Industrial Automation, Manufacturing, Installation, Fabrication, Machinery, or Engineering Projects** will be preferred.
* Experience in handling project teams, site execution, and client coordination is an advantage.

Salary

**Salary: As per Experience and Company Standards**

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Head of Operations – Multi-Unit Restaurants
description:
**Spingo Foods Private Limited/ Magic Food Zone** is looking for an experienced, dynamic, and results-driven Head of Operations to lead and oversee our multi-brand (Bikanervala, Bikano, Barista, Subway, Hotel & Magic Food Zone) restaurant and food court operations across Mathura, Vrindavan, Agra, and Jewar (Uttar Pradesh) .This leadership role is ideal for professionals with a strong background in QSR, restaurant chains, food courts, and large-scale hospitality operations who have successfully managed multiple outlets and delivered consistent business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end operations across multiple restaurant and food court locations.
* Drive sales growth, profitability, and operational excellence.
* Ensure strict compliance with SOPs, food safety, hygiene, and quality standards.
* Monitor and control food cost, labour cost, wastage, and key operational KPIs.
* Recruit, mentor, coach, and develop outlet management teams.
* Conduct regular operational audits, performance reviews, and compliance checks.
* Enhance customer experience and maintain high service standards across all outlets.
* Oversee manpower planning, hiring, training, scheduling, and productivity.
* Build MIS reports, analyze, identify operational gaps, and implement corrective actions.
* Support new outlet launches, business expansion, and process improvements.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 10+ years of experience in restaurant, QSR, food court, hotel, or large-scale hospitality operations.
* Proven track record of successfully managing multiple outlets.
* Strong understanding of restaurant P&L, cost control, inventory management, and operational efficiency.
* Excellent leadership, people management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to drive performance through teams while maintaining brand standards.
* Willingness to relocate to Mathura and travel extensively across Mathura, Vrindavan, Agra, and Jewar.

If you are passionate about operational excellence and building high-performing teams, we'd love to hear from you.Apply now or share your profile on **hr@magicfoods.in** to be part of our growing organization.

title: Benefits Operations Administrator
description:
**Designation\-Benefits Operations Administrator (BOA)**

**Key Expectations**

* Process all activities related to client benefit plans with high accuracy and timeliness.
* Consistently meet or exceed client Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Develop a strong understanding of client plan provisions and related documentation.
* Prioritize work effectively to respond to client and participant needs.
* Ensure adherence to predefined procedures, process guidelines, and compliance standards.
* Actively participate in daily huddles and status meetings to ensure smooth operations.

**Required Skills**

* Strong attention to detail and ability to handle transaction\-based processing.
* Good computer operating skills, including MS Office applications.
* Typing speed of minimum **25 WPM with 90% accuracy**.
* Good written and verbal communication skills are important.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross functional teams (CS, Tech, Shared Services).

**Role Description**


The **Benefits Operations Administrator (BOA)** is responsible for processing all activities related to client benefits plans as configured in organizational tools, while consistently meeting and exceeding client SLAs.


The role requires developing a strong understanding of client plan provisions, identifying opportunities for knowledge enhancement, and delivering work to high standards of quality and timeliness. The BOA is expected to prioritize work effectively, respond to client and participant needs in a timely manner, and ensure that all knowledge repositories, SOPs, and supporting documentation are current and accurate.


The incumbent conducts research, resolves, and responds to participant issues and inquiries using the case management tool, and collaborates closely with Customer Service, Technology, and other shared services teams for timely issue resolution.


Adherence to predefined procedures and process guidelines is critical to ensure performance parameters are consistently met or exceeded against SLA targets.


Soft Skills:

* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills
* Ability to multitask under tight timelines
* High level of accountability and ownership
* Customer‑centric mindset
* Adaptability to changing client requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (B.A, B.Com, B.Sc, BBA)
* Exclusions: B.Ed., LLB, B.Tech, BE, B.Sc (IT), Fulltime MBA, MCA, PDDCA, and any 2year regular postgraduation professional degree
